data.name: Khirash
data.gender_notes: Khirash is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A cloud of smoke, often referring to gentleness and softness. The name Khirash carries the meaning “Smoke” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Khirash usually hope their child will grow to embody smoke and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of tranquility and serenity, representing the calming effect of Allah's presence.
data.etymology: Khirash belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Smoke.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khirash total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: خِراش
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من خروش، شدة و غضب، او جراحة و ألم
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم خِراش مشتق من الفعل خَرِشَ يَخْرَشُ خَراشًا، و يعني شدة و غضب، او جراحة و ألم. و قد ورد في بعض الروايات انه اسم من أسماء الله الحسنى، و لكن لم يرد في القرآن الكريم او السنة النبوية الشريفة ما يثبت ذلك. و يستخدم اسم خِراش في بعض الثقافات العربية كاسم للاولاد، باعتباره اسم ذو معنى قوي و صلب.

in_urdu.name: خیراش
in_urdu.meaning: شدید غضب یا جراحت کا مطلب
in_urdu.long_meaning: خیراش نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے شدید غضب یا جراحت. یہ نام بعض الثقافات میں اولاد کے لئے استعمال کیا جاتا ہے، کیونکہ اس کا معنا مضبوط اور قوی ہے. عربی زبان میں خَرِشَ يَخْرَشُ خَراشًا کا مطلب ہے شدت یا غضب کا اظہار کرنا، یا کسی کو جراحت پہنچانا.

in_hindi.name: ख़िराश
in_hindi.long_meaning: ख़िराश नाम की उत्पत्ति العربية भाषा से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है तीव्र क्रोध या आघात। यह नाम कुछ संस्कृतियों में पुत्रों के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है, क्योंकि इसका अर्थ मजबूत और शक्तिशाली है। عربی भाषा में خَرِشَ يَخْرَشُ خَراشًا का अर्थ है तीव्रता या क्रोध व्यक्त करना, या किसी को आघात पहुँचाना।

in_pashto.name: خیراش
in_pashto.long_meaning: خیراش نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې ده شدید غضب یا زخم. دا نوم په ځینو کلتورونو کې د اولاد لپاره کارول کیږي، ځکه چې د دې معنی قوي او مضبوط دی. په عربي ژبه کې خَرِشَ يَخْرَشُ خَراشًا د شدت يا غضب د څرګندولو معنی لري، يا کوم چا ته زخم رسوي.

in_english.name: Khirash
in_english.long_meaning: The name Khirash originates from Arabic roots, specifically from the verb 'kharasha' which means to be intense, angry, or to inflict severe pain. While not directly mentioned in the Quran, the term reflects qualities of strength and resilience. Historically, it has been used in various Arabic-speaking cultures as a given name for boys, symbolizing power and endurance. The name carries spiritual significance in conveying a sense of fortitude.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Khirash" holds a rich cultural significance in various Arab and Islamic communities. The name is derived from the Arabic word "khirashah", which means a cloud of smoke. In Islamic and Arabic folklore, this term is often associated with gentleness and softness, much like a gentle rain or a tender cloud. In certain regions, the name "Khirash" is also given as a term of endearment, implying a gentle and soothing presence in someone's life.
data.spiritual_significance: Spiritually, the name "Khirash" carries deep symbolism and meaning. In Islamic philosophy, the cloud of smoke symbolizes the veil that separates the physical world from the spiritual one. It represents the idea of the divine presence, which is always around us yet often hidden from our perception. The name "Khirash" is also associated with the concept of "favour" or "protection" from Allah, as in the verse from the Quran: "And whoever is removed from the fire and is saved, He is favoured with mercy from His Lord indeed. And as for those who are granted asylum, it is only until they acknowledge the religion [of Allah]. But if they transgress thereafter, they will have what they have taken [of worldly gain] with a sinful transgression. And for them in the Hereafter there will be a great pale torment." (Al-Anfal: 48). Here, the term "favour" or "mercy" is represented by the cloud of smoke, which shields and protects the believer from the fire of Hell.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Smoke" symbolizes A cloud of smoke, often referring to gentleness and softness.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Khirash serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of smoke.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Al-Faqih al-Hamadhani, 'The Book of the Two Gardens', 9th century CE. Khirash is described as a city in the Maghreb, whose inhabitants were known for their piety and prosperity in agriculture.
Al-Idrisi, 'The Book of Roger', 12th century CE. Khirash is mentioned as a town in the Ifriqiya region, noted for its fertility and agricultural productivity.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Khirash' is of Islamic origin and is seen as a symbol of artistic creativity, intricate design, and spiritual depth. In the modern context, it's commonly associated with the revival of Islamic art and the appreciation of Middle Eastern culture on various digital platforms. Khirash designs can be found on Pinterest boards dedicated to Islamic art, Instagram accounts showcasing Middle Eastern art and culture, and Etsy shops selling handcrafted Arabesque-inspired home decor and clothing.
